item.description:
## Worksheet exercise names - Rename an exercise right on the worksheet page: double-click its name, or right-click and choose Rename Exercise. - Replacing an exercise now keeps its name and only updates the notation. Previously the name was overwritten with the Groove name, so renames didn't stick.
Also includes everything in 137. This build is 138.

## Faster chart tempo - Song Chart Builder now has a tempo slider, like the main window. - Click and drag the BPM number: right or up to speed up, left or down to slow down. Hold Option for fine control. - The arrows still step 1 BPM at a time, and a whole drag undoes in one step.
Also includes everything in 136. This build is 137.

## Safer saving - If your library can't be read in full, BeatBake now keeps a copy of the original file, opens everything it can, and tells you. Nothing is overwritten. - Pending saves finish when you close Chart Builder or quit. If a save fails on quit, you can cancel and keep working. - New or Open over an edited chart asks you to Save, Discard, or Cancel. - Groove undo now goes back 100 steps (was 5).
## Song Chart Builder - Choose individual bars or grouped rests when adding bars and sections. - Delete Bar button beside Add Bar. - Left/Right arrows move between bars, Up returns to bar 1, and the selected bar scrolls into view. - Chart Builder uses a single window: opening it again brings your chart forward. - Faster drawing and playback on long charts.
## Playback and licensing - Steadier timing at fast tempos. - The seven-day offline grace starts as soon as you activate your licence.
This build is 136 (was 133).
